translationRepairs: When Gaozu struck east against Xiang Ji, passing through Henan, at that time Fen was fifteen years old, serving as a minor official attending Gaozu.
When Gaozu struck east against Xiang Ji, passing through Henei, at that time Fen was fifteen years old, serving as a minor official attending Gaozu.
Chinese 過河內 names the commandery 河內 (Henei); literal Henan confuses it with 河南, and Henei matches the graph and the idiomatic rendering.
The servants and attendants Xin Xin as it should be, only cautious.
The servants and attendants were cheerful and only cautious.

Chinese 僮仆訢訢如也 uses 訢訢如也 as an adverbial manner phrase 'cheerfully', parallel to 申申如也; literal 'Xin Xin' wrongly treats it as a personal name, and 'were cheerful and only cautious' restores the sense with 唯謹.
He yielded to Qing with a letter, Qing was very ashamed, then again oversaw affairs.
He rebuked Qing by letter; Qing was very ashamed, then again oversaw affairs.

Chinese 以書讓慶 uses 讓 in the sense of reproach/rebuke (責讓); the emperor's prior rebuke context and Qing's shame confirm this is not 'yield', and 'rebuked Qing by letter' matches the idiomatic rendering.
The Marquis of Jianling Wei Wan was a person from Daliang in Dai.
The Marquis of Jianling Wei Wan was a person from Daling in Dai.
Chinese 代大陵人也 names the place 大陵 (Daling) in Dai; literal Daliang confuses it with 大梁, and Daling matches the graph and the idiomatic rendering.
